title: Jack Farley & Max Maxy: Foreign Markets Crushed US

excerpts.label: ACWI beat S&P, EM +34%
excerpts.insight: All Country World Index +22.4% beat S&P/NASDAQ. Emerging Markets +34%. Global bull market, not US monopoly.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: ROTATE to ACWI/EM now. Left 13-14% alpha on table. Overweight EEM, VWO—outperformance verified.

excerpts.label: South Korea +95%, memory boom
excerpts.insight: South Korea up 95.3% led by SK Hynix. China +31%, Japan +25.8%, Europe +35.6%.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG memory semis—SK Hynix, Micron. HBM shortage = 300-400% gains. Use trailing stops for glut risk.

excerpts.label: China 81 100-baggers vs US 43
excerpts.insight: Of 297 companies >$5B up >100%, China led with 81 vs US 43. Most unknown to Western investors.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: CHINA ACTIVE MANAGERS over MCHI. Index carries dead weight. 81 100-baggers = massive alpha opportunity.

excerpts.label: OpenAI $100B = AI continues
excerpts.insight: OpenAI raising $100B at $800B+ valuation. Capital markets open = capex boom persists.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: STAY LONG real AI—Nvidia, memory, data center. Exit when OpenAI down-round. Mid-cycle, not over.

excerpts.label: Hard landing only 9% concern
excerpts.insight: Investors rank recession 10th risk at 9%. AI bubble 57%. Labor-profit divergence unsustainable.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: HEDGE hard landing NOW. Long Treasuries, defensives, gold. Should be top 3 risk—major mispricing.

excerpts.label: Profits soar, labor weak
excerpts.insight: Profits up double-digits, labor softening. AI decoupling employment from earnings.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE consumer discretionary (+7.4%). LONG software, semis. Watch unemployment NOT earnings.

excerpts.label: 17% tariffs absorbed
excerpts.insight: Tariff rate 17% vs 2% pre-Trump. Feared 40%, got 15%. Margins absorbed—services insulated.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Service-sector longs SAFE. Importers proved resilient. Watch 2026 guidance for margin compression.
